items.label: Designed for Small Spaces
items.value: This 71-inch TV stand is ideal for 43''–50” TVs and supports up to 55” with a snug, edge-to-edge fit. Designed for apartments and compact living rooms, its low-profile height keeps your space open without bulky cabinets. Tip: Please measure your TV base width for best fit.

items.label: Low-Profile TV Stand for Comfortable Viewing
items.value: Unlike traditional tall entertainment centers, this low TV stand is designed for lazy sofa-level viewing, helping reduce neck strain while maintaining a clean, modern look. Ideal for bedrooms, gaming setups, and smaller living rooms.

items.label: Entertainment Center with LED Lights & Power Outlets
items.value: Built-in 3 AC outlets and 2 USB ports power your TV, gaming consoles, and devices with ease. LED light strips with multiple colors create an immersive gaming and movie experience, perfect for modern entertainment setups.

items.label: TV Stand with Storage Drawers & Open Shelves
items.value: Features 5 fabric drawers for hidden storage and adjustable side shelves for consoles, speakers, and décor. Keeps your living room or bedroom organized without taking up too much space.

items.label: Durable & Stable Construction with Easy Assembly Support
items.value: Sturdy Steel Frame with Easy-to-Follow Assembly Instructions. Built with a reinforced steel frame and durable wood boards for stability and long-term use. Includes a center support leg and anti-tip kit. All parts are numbered with illustrated instructions included. Customer support is available within 24 hours for installation or product issues.

items.label: Ideal for Apartments & Bedrooms, Not for Large Spaces
items.value: Perfect for apartments, bedrooms, and compact spaces. If you have a large or open living room, a taller and wider TV stand may be more suitable.
